title: Chapter 30
text: Readers love the Tales From Verania by TJ Klune The Lightning-Struck Heart “ The Lightning-Struck Heart a stunning fantasy novel that I am certain will go down as one of the top m/m literary picks of the year 2015.” —Joyfully Jay “…this book was just the confirmation of the great talent TJ has, a terrific gift he absolutely needs to continue to share with us.” —Scattered Thoughts and Rogue Words A Destiny of Dragons “All told, A Destiny of Dragons is the perfect summer read. It’s got action! Adventure! Romance! Danger! Hilarity! Snark!” —The Novel Approach “ A Destiny of Dragons is an absolutely brilliant continuation of The Lightning-Struck Heart …” —Open Sky Book Reviews “This is pure unadulterated pleasure, a fabulous fantasy read. I loved it.” —Sinfully: Gay Romance Book Reviews
